The bowl is about 15 cm across at the rim and holds a mound of white, curdy food that looks like cottage cheese. It could also be rice or ricotta, but the lumpy, moist curds point to cottage cheese. The mound is roughly 10 cm by 8 cm and about 4 cm tall. That gives a volume of about 200 ml, which I'd scale to roughly 170 g at a density near 1 g/ml with some air gaps. Cottage cheese runs about 98 kcal per 100 g.
